create.name: Ally Boothroyd
create.bio:
Ally Boothroyd is a Canadian yoga and Yoga Nidra teacher from the Kawartha Lakes area of Ontario, where she founded Sarovara Yoga. She started practising in 2003 and took her first 200-hour training with Randal Williams of Kripalu, later assisting him on his Yoga Nidra programmes; that apprenticeship set the course of her work. Since 2013 she and Tiina Kivinen have trained new teachers in the Amrita Yoga lineage, and the two now co-direct the 200- and 300-hour programmes of the School of Living Yoga.

Much of her teaching now happens online. She runs a self-paced 100-hour Yoga Nidra teacher training with live Zoom calls, a nine-month 200-hour yoga teacher training, a restorative yoga training paced by the lunar cycle, and the Living Yoga Online Studio with live classes every day. In person she leads small retreats in Ontario, British Columbia and Costa Rica. Her YouTube channel, Sarovara Yoga, holds a large free library of guided Yoga Nidra for deep rest, chakra-themed practices and gentle hatha classes, and she shares similar recordings on Insight Timer. Her style is unhurried and voice-led, often set against ocean or rainforest sound.

courses.title: Transformational Sleep: Online 100-Hour Yoga Nidra Teacher Training
courses.description: A self-paced online training in how to practise and guide Yoga Nidra, from intention (sankalpa) and the koshas to writing and recording your own scripts. It comes with lifetime access and a run of weekly live Zoom calls with Ally and her faculty; full tuition is in the information pack.

courses.title: Embodied Wisdom Online 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A nine-month live online hatha yoga teacher training that Ally co-directs with Tiina Kivinen for the School of Living Yoga, with lifetime access to the recordings. The next cohort is listed to begin on 25 September 2027.

courses.title: Moon to Moon Online 70-Hour Restorative Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: An online restorative yoga training that most students complete over about four lunar cycles, at their own pace. It teaches how to lead slow, supported restorative classes; the next intake is listed for 8 December 2026.

courses.title: Living Yoga Online Studio
courses.description: A membership with live online classes on every day of the week and an on-demand library, taught by Ally and the Living Yoga faculty. Classes span Yoga Nidra, meditation, restorative, gentle and vinyasa yoga, and a free trial week is offered.

courses.title: Yoga and Yoga Nidra Retreats with Ally Boothroyd
courses.description: Small residential retreats led by Ally and her teaching team, held in Ontario, on Bowen Island in British Columbia and on the Pacific coast of Costa Rica. Days centre on yoga, Yoga Nidra and time in nature; dates and details are released on the retreats page.

free_resources.title: Ally Boothroyd on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided Yoga Nidra, short rest practices, chakra meditations and pranayama from Ally, some with singing bowl or nature sound. Listen free in the app or on the web.
